findings.message: F750 is the feed in force when CYCLE840 runs on line 9. A tapping cycle written as a call can take its thread lead from that feed (the feed is then the spindle speed times the pitch), so it is left as written: scaled, it would cut a different thread. Scale it by hand if the cycle takes its lead from its own arguments.
